nodes.summary: It is not the case that for every natural number $n > 3$ the automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$ of the free group on $n$ generators is automatic.

nodes.summary: The statement that for every natural number $n > 3$ the automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$ of the free group $F_n$ on $n$ generators is an automatic group.
